text_block_list.text:
Seems Sakura Bakushin O name
becomes more well known, partly
due to recently issued victory suit.
Then, one day――

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oya, visitor?

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
President of Public Relations
Committee.

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of writing feature article
for next month issue on Umamusume
who recently received victory
suits.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Means you interview me?
Interviewing me, right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Straight from same kind of
"president" as me…
…Fufu, simply cannot refuse!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good, right, Trainer?

Good to get more media
exposure.

Sakura Bakushin O peers were Rice
Shower, Mihono Bourbon, Nishino
Flower.

Not to be overshadowed, want
actively promote her and raise
profile――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Allow me to tell all about fascinating
appeal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right!
We Umamusume shine only when running!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, head down to track!
Please look upon me running in
victory suit!

Sakura Bakushin O grabbed victory
suit and walked out alone.

Apologized to PR chair
and committee members, headed to
track in pursuit of Sakura
Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu-fu-fu!
What think of sharp, dignified
victory uniform?

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic!
Cherry blossom motif suits you
well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, of course!
Running make me shine brighter!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Without further ado, off!
choice_data_list: Go ahead and Bakushin to your heart's content!
Go ahead and Bakushin to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Affirmative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Dressed in victory suit, precisely
One True・Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uooooooohhhh! Please gaze upon power of rebirthed self!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
What speed…!
Without doubt, "Bakushin Dash"
――fastest of fast!
choice_data_list: That was one of the best runs I've ever seen!
That was one of the best runs I've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, mistaken!
True power not like this at all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Next time, even faster――Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Kidding!
Still getting faster…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, push limits further――
Bakushin, Bakushiii―n…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew… phew…
Th-that approximately it!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, got great shots!
Looks like great article coming,
Miss President!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Yes! "Speed reminiscent of
legend."
Headline decided!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
That all for us.
Thank you for cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nothing…
Let's… again… sometime!

As soon as said, Sakura
Bakushin O plopped down.

Strength already at limit.
Endurance still issue.

Regardless, article well written,
succeeded in raising profile of
Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood, leave to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Without sliver of doubt, show
100% power and overflowing enthusiasm!

Wanted photos same time, decided
interview after Sakura Bakushin O
changed into victory suit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you kindly for waiting!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic!
Cherry blossom motif suits you
well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Of course, of course!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Heard was Bakushin O-san wish
to include cherry blossom motif?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative!
After all, "Sakura" Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From day given name, destiny
set in stone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, must shine like cherry
blossoms in full bloom and keep
Bakushin-ing on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Cannot think of more appropriate motif for
victory suit than cherry blossoms!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bloom both as competitor and
class president!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for great story.
Looks like good article coming!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nothing! Next, tell
class president episode, essential
part of story!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
What?
No, story for another time――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy!
Hear it all way through!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
――and so, journey as class
president began!

text_block_list.name: PR Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: I-is that so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From now on, always honest and
righteous!
As class president, keep Bakushin-ing!

…Thus ended interview with Sakura
Bakushin O.

Article well written and succeeded
in raising profile of Sakura Bakushin O.
